tasks.title: Open Perio for Marisol Vega from your first card
tasks.success: route hygienist/perio/enc-9001; cursor at tooth 1 site 1 (or the first present tooth); the prior exam is ghosted
tasks.watch: does the Chairs card tell you what changed (anticoagulant), what is due (perio 14 mo, BWX), and what helped last time?

tasks.title: Full-mouth six-point perio, keyboard only, one pass
steps: type 168 digits (mostly 2-4, some 5-6, use Space after a few for bleeding)
tasks.success: a perioExams row with probed 168 (minus missing teeth sites), notes[enc-9001].perioSummary present; Save was one tap; no omission licence needed
tasks.watch: did the cursor ever jump somewhere you did not expect? Did the active-site display keep you oriented?

tasks.title: Undo a mistyped depth and skip a site without recording zero
tasks.success: the undone site shows the corrected value; the skipped site is stored as not probed (never 0); saving asks for an omission licence (refusal code omission_licence) and perio.licence.<code> then perio.licence.confirm completes the save
tasks.watch: was the undo feedback visible for a gloved user looking at the mouth, not the screen?

tasks.title: Tag #30 for the dentist as a finding, not a diagnosis
steps: type 30 in perio.tag.tooth and 'suspected caries DO' in perio.tag.text
tasks.success: a tags row for enc-9001 with tooth 30 and no disposition; the copy says finding, not diagnosis
tasks.watch: does the licence scope feel respected rather than policed?

tasks.title: Mark ready for exam
tasks.success: an appointmentEvents write encounter.exam_requested; the Exams-to-sign queue (dentist persona) would list it
